workflow_runs.display_title: Add WebRTC transport to realtime start

head_commit.message:
Reuse realtime start for WebRTC

Move WebRTC SDP negotiation onto thread/realtime/start via an optional transport and emit the answer SDP as a realtime notification instead of returning it from a separate request.

Rebased onto latest origin/main and resolved conflicts by keeping the new endpoint re-export structure while adding realtime call support.

Co-authored-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>
